# Version 4.150.2
> **Ganesh failure handling** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves GPU failure handling and corrects a native shader-code generation use-after-free.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed GPU work no longer leaves stale readbacks** — Propagates failed Ganesh flushes to readback and restores resolve dirty tracking when a task does not execute. Includes further failed-flush and Imagination GPU framebuffer-deletion corrections. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))
- **Shader-code generation lifetime** — Corrects an upstream SkSL RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
